contexts.text: For spiritual and celestial things infinitely transcend human apprehension.
Love like the Lord's transcends all human understanding.
Because they transcend man's apprehension.
Man cannot apprehend any doctrinal which is purely spiritual and celestial, that is. Divine, because it infinitely transcends his apprehension, and thus his faith. AC 2568:5.
The appearances of truth in which the Angels are, immensely transcend the understanding of man.
As these subjects transcend the apprehension of the natural man...
For goods and truths Divine... transcend and become infinite.
For man can have no idea whatever of the Lord's Supreme Divine, because it so transcends his idea as to utterly perish.
As the inmost or supreme sense of the Word transcends the human understanding...
One who utters adaptedly to the understanding the Divine truth which proceeds from the Lord immediately, and which transcends all understanding. Signified.
The Infinite is such that it transcends all finite understanding...
See Third Heaven. HH 210.
For truth in a form not accommodated, such as is in Heaven, transcends the understanding; and that which transcends the understanding is not received.
I know that this transcends belief.
This form transcends all intelligence.
The wisdom of the Angels so far transcends human wisdom that they cannot be compared; and that which transcends appears as if it were not anything. HH 267:2.
Divine love cannot transcend these laws.

I know that these things transcend the ideas of thoughts which are in natural light; but they do not transcend those which are in spiritual light... and they do not quite transcend them even in natural light...
For the love and wisdom of the higher Angels... transcends the perception (of the lower ones).
Both (the Lord's) Humans are Divine, and therefore infinitely transcend the finite humans of Angels and men.
So much of the understanding as transcends, that is, which is not of the love... is an appearance.
They who believe that spiritual or theological things transcend the understanding... DP 149.
By death men pass from one world into the other.
Indefinitely transcend organic forms.
Geometricians suppose that nothing can transcend (their science).
A notion of forms which transcend geometrical ones.
That theological things do not transcend...
(Their writing) contains arcana which transcend the understanding of the (lower) Angels.
But passes from death into life () = resurrection and life in Heaven.
He who oversteps one commandment... does not fear to overstep all the rest, although he may not actually overstep them. Explained.
As (this) cannot but transcend the apprehension.
The delights of Heaven infinitely transcend...

With men this Truth appears to transcend... yet it does not so transcend human understanding but that it may be seen as through a lattice... It does not transcend my own, which is an illustrated rational one.
5. 3. The thoughts of the spiritual, and also their affections... transcend natural ideas, and do not fall into them except in some measure into the interior rational sight...
